title: CDMO Competitor Capability Database
description: A structured, verified reference for three major Indian CDMO players tracked by APAC Sourcing Intelligence: Divi's Laboratories, Sai Life Sciences, and Cohance Lifesciences. Built for a sourcing and procurement company that needs to know, per competitor, what they can make, the chemistries and technology platforms they run, the products and intermediates they supply, and the hard metrics that qualify them. Everything is categorised broad to narrow: Company then Business Segment then Capability Domain then Chemistry or Capability then Product or Intermediate.
purpose: Vendor intelligence and sourcing shortlist support. Use to match a molecule or chemistry need to the right partner, benchmark scale and regulatory footprint, and spot white space.
currency: INR crore unless stated. 1 crore = 10 million. USD figures are approximate at roughly 83 INR per USD.
methodology: Compiled from company websites, investor filings and annual reports, exchange disclosures, PharmaCompass, and reputable trade and financial press. Figures carry an 'asOf' where the source dates them. Verify DMF counts, certifications, and capacity against the latest filings before contractual use.

levels.name: Company
levels.note: The legal entity and its overall profile and scale metrics.

levels.name: Business Segment
levels.note: Broad lines of business, for example CDMO custom synthesis, generic APIs, specialty chemicals, nutraceuticals, discovery services.

levels.name: Capability Domain
levels.note: Families of capability that cut across segments, defined in capabilityDomains below.

levels.name: Chemistry or Capability
levels.note: The specific reaction class, technology platform, or unit operation.

levels.name: Product or Intermediate
levels.note: Named molecules, APIs, intermediates, or product families.

capabilityDomains.name: Technology Platforms
capabilityDomains.note: Enabling process technologies: continuous flow, biocatalysis, photochemistry, high pressure, solid phase peptide synthesis, bioconjugation.

capabilityDomains.name: Chemistry and Reaction Toolbox
capabilityDomains.note: Core synthetic reaction classes the site is equipped and experienced to run at scale.

capabilityDomains.name: Containment and High Potency
capabilityDomains.note: High potency API handling, occupational exposure band capability, dedicated containment suites.

capabilityDomains.name: Particle Engineering and Solid State
capabilityDomains.note: Milling, micronization, polymorph and crystallisation control, particle size distribution.

capabilityDomains.name: Modalities
capabilityDomains.note: The molecule classes served: small molecules, peptides, oligonucleotides, antibody drug conjugates and their payloads.

capabilityDomains.name: Analytical and Regulatory
capabilityDomains.note: Analytical infrastructure, regulatory filings such as DMFs and CoS, and inspection track record.

capabilityDomains.name: Service Scope
capabilityDomains.note: Where along discovery to commercial the company plays: discovery, process development and CMC, and commercial manufacturing.

companies.name: Divi's Laboratories Limited
companies.listed: Publicly listed on NSE and BSE (2003)
companies.ownership: Public; promoter family led by Dr. Murali K. Divi
companies.positioning: One of the world's largest merchant API and custom synthesis manufacturers, focused on high barrier to entry chemistry with deep backward integration and cost leadership.
companies.businessModel: Merchant API manufacturer plus CDMO custom synthesis for innovators, plus a nutraceutical carotenoid business. Not a full discovery CRDMO.

segments.name: Generic APIs
segments.note: Large scale, backward integrated generic active ingredients where Divi's holds dominant global share in select molecules.

segments.name: Custom Synthesis (CDMO)
segments.note: Contract manufacture of intermediates and APIs for global innovators, including late stage and commercial.

segments.name: Nutraceuticals
segments.note: Carotenoids for food, feed, and dietary supplement markets.

sites.name: Unit II
sites.role: API and custom synthesis manufacturing, includes export oriented SEZ (DCV / DC SEZ) units

sites.name: Unit III (Kakinada)
sites.role: New brownfield capacity for APIs and custom synthesis

regulatory.note: Facilities inspected by US FDA and other major regulators; strong compliance record.

tech-platforms.name: Continuous flow chemistry
tech-platforms.maturity: In use at lab and pilot scale, scaling toward commercial
tech-platforms.note: Green chemistry and safer handling of hazardous steps.

tech-platforms.name: Biocatalysis
tech-platforms.note: Enzymatic steps for selectivity and greener routes.

tech-platforms.name: Solid phase peptide synthesis (SPPS)
tech-platforms.note: Multiple 500 litre reactors installed for peptides, further expansion underway.

chemistry-toolbox.name: Iodination
chemistry-toolbox.note: Underpins iodinated X-ray contrast media intermediates.

containment-hpapi.name: High potency API handling
containment-hpapi.note: Purpose built containment suites for highly potent compounds.

modalities.name: Peptides
modalities.note: GLP-1 class peptides and intermediates a strategic growth area.

services.name: Custom synthesis of intermediates and APIs

nutraceuticals.name: Carotenoids (full range)
nutraceuticals.note: Widely documented range includes beta carotene, lycopene, lutein, astaxanthin, canthaxanthin, and apo ester, for food, feed, and supplements. Confirm exact grades with the company.

companies.sourcingAngle: Best fit for large volume, high barrier generic APIs and complex custom synthesis where scale, cost, and reliability matter. Dominant single source risk in a few molecules (naproxen, dextromethorphan). Rising option for GLP-1 peptide intermediates and contrast media intermediates. Less of a fit for early discovery or biologics.

companies.name: Sai Life Sciences Limited
companies.listed: IPO and listing on NSE and BSE, December 2024
companies.ownership: Public; earlier backed by TPG and other investors
companies.positioning: Integrated CRDMO for small molecule new chemical entities, taking innovator programs from discovery through development to commercial manufacturing.
companies.businessModel: Full service Contract Research, Development and Manufacturing Organisation (CRDMO) on a hub and spoke model: low cost high scale execution in India with front end discovery and development labs in the UK and USA.

metrics.profitNote: Profit after tax up ~105% in FY25
metrics.reactorCapacityBidar: ~700 KL total installed after Block 11 Phase II (Q1 FY26)

segments.note: Integrated medicinal chemistry, biology, DMPK, and toxicology, concept to clinic.

segments.note: Process development, scale up, analytical development, and early phase supplies.

segments.name: Manufacturing (CDMO)
segments.note: cGMP manufacture of advanced intermediates and APIs from clinical to commercial.

sites.role: Front end research, bridge between discovery and manufacturing

regulatory.note: Bidar site inspected by US FDA and PMDA. Confirm current DMF and CEP filings with the company.

chemistry-toolbox.name: Complex multi step small molecule synthesis
Hazardous and specialised reactions handled via flow

containment-hpapi.name: High potency API (HPAPI) capability
containment-hpapi.note: Invested niche area for potent compounds. Confirm OEB banding with the company.

particle-solid-state.name: Process and analytical development supporting solid form selection
particle-solid-state.note: Confirm micronization and polymorph services with the company.

analytical-regulatory.name: Integrated analytical development and QC supporting CMC filings

products.note: Sai Life works on confidential innovator NCE programs rather than a public catalog of generic APIs. Output is client owned advanced intermediates and APIs across a 170+ molecule pipeline (38 late stage, 7 commercial).

therapeuticFocus: Innovator small molecule NCEs across oncology, CNS, metabolic, and other areas (client driven)
companies.sourcingAngle: Best fit when you need an integrated partner to move a novel small molecule from discovery through to commercial supply with a single tech transfer, especially for programs that value UK and US front end research proximity. Less suited to off the shelf generic API sourcing.

companies.name: Cohance Lifesciences Limited
companies.founded: Formed as an integrated platform by Advent International through acquisitions; merged with Suven Pharmaceuticals in 2025
companies.listed: Listed on NSE and BSE (post merger, under Cohance Lifesciences)
companies.positioning: Integrated CRDMO and API platform with multi modality capability spanning small molecules, high potency APIs, antibody drug conjugates, oligonucleotides, and specialty chemicals.
companies.businessModel: Built by combining several businesses (ZCL Chemicals, Avra Laboratories, Suven Pharmaceuticals, Sapala Organics, and NJ Bio) into one platform covering Pharma CDMO, Specialty Chemicals CDMO, and APIs, with next generation ADC and oligonucleotide capability.
companies.mergerNote: Suven Pharmaceuticals and Cohance merged in 2025 to create a roughly one billion dollar scale CDMO; the merged entity operates as Cohance Lifesciences Limited.

revenue.note: Combined revenue of the merging entities in FY24; management target of ~6,000 crore by FY29.

metrics.facilities: 20+ across India and the United States
metrics.adcCapacity: cGMP bioconjugation suite up to ~2 kg ADC, sufficient for clinical needs up to Phase 2b
